elenavogue.name: Elena Vogue
elenavogue.title: Beauty Editor
elenavogue.bio: Elena has spent a decade in the beauty industry, from Parisian runways to New York labs. She's passionate about clean beauty, skin science, and the art of self-care.

clara-thorne.name: Clara Thorne
clara-thorne.title: Senior Beauty Writer
clara-thorne.bio: Clara has her finger on the pulse of the beauty industry. From the streets of Paris to the labs of Seoul, she covers the stories that matter.

celestearnaud.name: Celeste Arnaud
celestearnaud.title: Skincare Specialist
celestearnaud.bio: Celeste is a certified esthetician with a passion for holistic skincare. She believes true beauty starts with healthy, radiant skin.

marcus-sterling.name: Marcus Sterling
marcus-sterling.title: Celebrity Editor
marcus-sterling.bio: Marcus brings you the latest from Hollywood and beyond. With a sharp eye for style and a nose for news, he's your go-to for all things celebrity.

sophia-delacroix.name: Sophia Delacroix
sophia-delacroix.title: Fashion Editor
sophia-delacroix.bio: Sophia has been at the forefront of fashion for over 15 years, covering the world's biggest shows and discovering emerging talent. She believes style is a language.

olivia-greene.name: Olivia Greene
olivia-greene.title: Lifestyle Writer
olivia-greene.bio: Olivia explores the intersection of wellness, travel, and modern living. She finds joy in simple pleasures and sharing stories that inspire a balanced life.

margaret-hayes.name: Margaret Hayes
margaret-hayes.title: Culture Critic
margaret-hayes.bio: Margaret examines the arts, literature, and society with a critical and compassionate lens. She believes culture is the heartbeat of humanity.

sophie-hart.name: Sophie Hart
sophie-hart.title: Wedding Editor
sophie-hart.bio: Sophie has planned and attended countless weddings, from intimate elopements to grand celebrations. She shares inspiration, tips, and real‑love stories.
